input.jobDescription: Synthetic QA opening for Frontend Engineer. Build React and TypeScript interfaces, implement keyboard accessibility, write unit tests, and collaborate using Git. Bachelor degree in Computer Science preferred. This is not a real job posting.

issues: Skills section is isolated at the bottom rather than integrated into experience bullets
details: Proprietary Workday parser successfully reads single-column text layout without tables or multi-column issues, but standalone skill lists are notoriously underweighted by Workday's parsing logic.

matched: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science

highlights: Included Vitest unit testing and 20 percent metric on form load time.

notes: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science from Example University with 2024 graduation year parses cleanly.

suggestions.summary: Integrate missing keywords from the job description into your experience bullet points
details: Change your experience bullet 'Implemented React and TypeScript forms with keyboard navigation' to 'Collaborated with team members to implement React and TypeScript interfaces and forms with keyboard navigation'
Workday's HiredScore AI prioritizes skills appearing directly within experience text rather than isolated skills sections.

issues: Clean standard layout but prone to exact-string mismatch if OCR encounters formatting quirks
details: Taleo's strict OCR-based parser requires exact chronological placement and standard section headers to prevent dropping text segments.

matched: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science

highlights: Experience roles and dates are clearly structured.

notes: Degree title 'Bachelor of Science in Computer Science' matches the preferred qualification literal text.

suggestions.summary: Adjust your bullet text to match Taleo's literal keyword matching engine
details: Change your summary 'Frontend engineer building accessible web interfaces' to match the JD exact phrase 'Frontend Engineer building React and TypeScript interfaces'
Taleo uses literal exact keyword matching and will fail to score points if terms like 'interfaces' and 'Engineer' do not match the JD case and word form exactly.
HireAbility ALEX parser processes the resume contextually and extracts metadata cleanly.

highlights: Vitest unit test volume and page load time metric add semantic depth.

notes: Degree meets the preferred education criteria completely.

suggestions.summary: Add collaboration context to satisfy the job requirement for team cooperation
details: Change your experience bullet 'Added 18 unit tests with Vitest for form validation and error recovery' to 'Collaborated with cross-functional peers, adding 18 unit tests with Vitest for form validation and error recovery'
iCIMS's semantic ensemble ML engine searches for collaboration indicators alongside technical skills.
Modern LLM-based parser handles simple text layouts with near-perfect skill and date extraction.

highlights: Clear technical descriptions map smoothly via semantic embeddings.

notes: Clean education block parses directly into Greenhouse candidate profile fields.

suggestions.summary: Expand your experience section to cover the missing collaboration requirement
details: Change your experience bullet 'Implemented React and TypeScript forms with keyboard navigation' to 'Collaborated with engineering teams to build and implement React and TypeScript interfaces with keyboard navigation'
Greenhouse recruiters rely on semantic searches combining React, TypeScript, and collaboration; adding the missing term ensures you surface in recruiter boolean filters.
Parser extracts standard text cleanly but relies entirely on recruiter search terms since no scoring algorithm exists.

highlights: Word stemming helps variations like 'implemented' match recruiter queries for 'implement'.

suggestions.summary: Include explicit mention of team collaboration to match standard recruiter search queries
details: Change your summary 'Frontend engineer building accessible web interfaces' to 'Frontend Engineer collaborating on React and TypeScript web interfaces'
Lever does not score or rank candidates, making keyword discoverability through recruiter search paramount.
Textkernel parser accurately normalizes job titles and extracts technical skills into the SAP skills framework taxonomy.

highlights: Taxonomy mapping recognizes React and TypeScript as core framework competencies.

notes: Degree and graduation year extracted cleanly into structured education fields.

suggestions.summary: Incorporate the missing collaboration skill into your experience section
details: Change your experience bullet 'Reduced a synthetic test page load time by 20 percent' to 'Collaborated with team members to optimize code, reducing a synthetic test page load time by 20 percent'
SuccessFactors stack ranking with AI Units evaluates skills alignment against the organization's enterprise skills taxonomy.
